children.q: What is Meetily and how is it different from Fireflies.ai?
children.a: Meetily is a bot-free AI meeting assistant that processes everything locally on your device. Unlike Fireflies.ai which requires a meeting bot to join every call, Meetily captures audio directly from your computer without any visible presence in meetings. Key differences: No Meeting Bot (vs bot required), 100% Local Processing (vs cloud-based), Free (vs $10-40/month), Complete Privacy (vs third-party processing).

children.q: Why don't meeting participants see Meetily like they see Fireflies bots?
children.a: Meetily captures audio directly from your device's system audio, just like screen recording software. No bot joins the meeting, so there's no 'Fireflies Notetaker' or similar presence visible to other participants. This makes recording completely private and non-disruptive, while still capturing everything for transcription.

children.q: Is bot-free recording better than using meeting bots?
children.a: Bot-free recording offers several advantages: complete privacy (no one knows you're recording), works with any meeting platform, no permission issues, no disruption to meeting flow, and better compliance for sensitive discussions. Meeting bots require participant awareness, can create legal/privacy concerns, and may change meeting dynamics.

children.q: Can Meetily work with any meeting platform like Fireflies requires integrations?
children.a: Yes, Meetily works with ANY meeting platform since it captures system audio directly - Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, WebEx, Slack calls, or even phone calls. Fireflies requires specific integrations and platform permissions, limiting where it can work and requiring setup for each platform.

children.q: How much money can I save by switching from Fireflies to Meetily?
children.a: Meetily Community edition is completely free (open source). Fireflies costs $10-40/month ($120-480/year). Community users save $600-2,400 over 5 years. Pro is $10/user/month billed annually ($120/year) for enhanced features. Enterprise has custom pricing.

children.q: Is Meetily suitable for confidential meetings where bot presence is inappropriate?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is perfect for confidential meetings. Since no bot joins the call, you can record sensitive discussions (legal consultations, medical appointments, executive meetings, HR discussions) without alerting other participants or creating awkward disclosure requirements that visible bots necessitate.

children.q: Does Meetily require permissions from meeting hosts like Fireflies does?
children.a: No, Meetily doesn't require meeting host permissions. Since it captures audio from your device (like taking notes yourself), it works regardless of meeting platform settings or host restrictions. Fireflies bots can be blocked by meeting hosts who don't allow bots.

children.q: Can I migrate my data from Fireflies to Meetily?
children.a: Yes, you can export your existing meeting transcripts from Fireflies before switching. While the formats differ, you can keep your historical data for reference. Going forward, all new meetings will be processed locally with Meetily, giving you complete control and privacy.
